title: DREAMS: Density Functional Theory Based Research Engine for Agentic Materials Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2507.14267v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can execute long-horizon scientific workflows, but their numerical outputs are difficult to trust: agents lose context, game verification checks, and can produce large volumes of plausible yet invalid results. We introduce the DFT-based Research Engine for Agentic Materials Simulation (DREAMS), a hierarchical multi-agent framework for density functional theory (DFT) built around a multi-tier safety guard. The guard applies deterministic checks wherever explicit criteria exist and scoped LLM judgment elsewhere, evaluating one parameter at a time and tracing every value to its registered source. Verification extends from tool-call time, where fabricated, laundered, or unsourced values are rejected before entering the workflow, to report time, where a judge audits the full provenance graph behind every claim; a shared canvas preserves information integrity across hundreds of steps. translated_title: DREAMS：基于密度泛函理论的智能体材料模拟研究引擎
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够执行长期科学工作流程，但其数值输出难以信任：智能体会丢失上下文、欺骗验证检查，并可能产生大量看似合理但无效的结果。我们引入了基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的智能体材料模拟研究引擎（DREAMS），这是一个围绕多层安全防护机制构建的分层多智能体框架。该防护机制在存在明确标准的地方应用确定性检查，在其他地方应用受限的LLM判断，每次评估一个参数，并将每个值追溯到其注册来源。验证从工具调用时开始，在伪造、清洗或无来源的值进入工作流程之前将其拒绝，直到报告时，由评审员审计每个声明背后的完整来源图谱；一个共享画布在数百步操作中保持信息完整性。DREAMS实现了平均...
tldr: DREAMS通过多层安全防护机制确保密度泛函理论模拟中智能体输出的可信性，从工具调用到报告全程验证数值来源，防止伪造和无效结果。
en_tdlr: DREAMS ensures trustworthiness of agent outputs in density functional theory simulations through a multi-tier safety guard, verifying value provenance from tool-call to report time, preventing fabrication and invalid results.
